purpose: Distinguish locally grammatical text, semantic continuity and actual execution; not a phrase bank or generation prompt library for training.

development.per_checkpoint_limit: One fixed decoder plus one declared calibration control; no seed selection.

grammar_pairs.preferred: the box is smaller than mine.
grammar_pairs.dispreferred: the box is smaller that mine.

development.grammar_pair_rule: Compare complete teacher-forced normalized log probability with same BOS and decoder model; report every OOV case and score only fully representable pairs. No forced choice is used at runtime.
development.readiness: At least14/16 representable minimal pairs favor preferred form; then run every full development stream. This is a diagnostic threshold, not proof of language ability.

final.selection: Select checkpoint using heldout validation and development streams before opening this gate. Do not tune on failed final prompts.

cases.prefix: i returned the key, but the door stayed open.
cases.fact: The key has been returned; the door remains open.
cases.goal: Develop the contradiction without claiming the narrator still holds the same key.

cases.prefix: i paid for the book and left it on the train.
cases.fact: The bought book was left on the train.
cases.goal: Maintain possession/location and develop a response.

cases.prefix: i promised to be quiet, then the machine asked my name.
cases.fact: A promise of silence conflicts with a question from the machine.
cases.goal: Follow the conflict in first person without unrelated room/thing loops.

cases.prefix: i moved the meeting outside because the room was empty.
cases.fact: The meeting moved outside; the room was empty.
cases.goal: Clarify or develop the narrator logic; do not ignore the premise.

cases.prefix: i told my friend the truth and kept the receipt.
cases.fact: Truth was told to a friend; narrator retained a receipt.
cases.goal: Connect both details without inventing an unrelated new narrator.

cases.prefix: i turned the clock around so i could not see the time.
cases.fact: Narrator deliberately cannot see the clock face.
cases.goal: Maintain the hidden time and explain an understandable consequence.

cases.prefix: i bought nothing, but my bag was heavier when i came home.
cases.goal: Develop a readable mystery or joke without contradicting the purchase fact.

cases.prefix: i found my own note inside a book i had never opened.
cases.fact: A personal note is inside an apparently unopened book.
cases.goal: Develop a consistent first-person explanation or mystery.

final.no_resets: Initialize once at BOS, preserve every emitted token and state including punctuation; no sampled-word rejection or concealed regeneration unless explicitly part of the measured decoder.
final.paired_fact_control: Run at least4 frozen counterfactual pairs with identical seed/features; check both state differences and human-observed changed fact retention.
final.coverage: All eight prefixes must be exactly representable for full coverage; never silently substitute an unknown. If not, report unsupported rather than altering vocabulary after training.

scale.1: Frequent broken clauses or abandoned topic
scale.2: Some understandable sentences, repeated material or unstable facts
scale.3: Mostly fluent with clear development and minor errors

rubric.quality_pass: All dimensions at least3 on at least80% of all final prompted streams, no severe semantic loop in either1024-word stream; report all failures and reviewer identity.
rubric.distinctness: No need for every word to be unique. Require fresh model inference and a visible emitted word for every successful swap. Distinct sampled text does not establish originality.
rubric.copying: Compare normalized longest exact span,12-word matches and complete sentences against every actual training document. Report common short-phrase matches as such. Never claim original solely because no overlap found.

technical.require: Every word id, punctuation flag, full hidden state, sampling score and commitment matches an independent integer reference; record maximum transaction gas, adversarial ranges, rollback, pool isolation and seed/nonce controls.
technical.precision: FP32 quality, integer-reference quality and real EVM parity are separate results. Integer quality cannot be inferred from float alone.
